Begin by noticing where your body touches the chair, bed or floor. Let it hold you.
[pause 34]
Let your breathing find its own easy rhythm.
[pause 34]
[repeat 3]
[in 4] Breathe in
[out 6] And out, slowly

Now we'll move attention slowly through the body. Wherever it lands, simply notice what's there.
Bring your attention to your feet and toes. Notice warmth or coolness, pressure, tingling, or nothing at all.
If you find tension, breathe towards it, and let it soften on the out-breath.
